faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Cotati?
faq.answer: Cotati homeowners typically invest $4,000 to $8,500 for a full window replacement project. This small Sonoma County city features modest 1960s–1980s homes with standard window sizing. Projects typically cover 8–12 windows. Single window installation starts at approximately $400.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Cotati?
faq.answer: Yes. Cotati requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Cotati Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Cotati?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Cotati commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Cotati?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Cotati replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Cotati?
faq.answer: Most Cotati projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
